reason: First run after the launch spine merged (PR #152, #202, #203). The default branch has never been exercised on real hardware: the committed live evidence still fingerprints against a pre-merge tree, and the iOS simulator + MCP phases have no post-merge run at all. This establishes the baseline every later request is compared against.
notes: `everything` covers proofs -> API -> MCP over real JSON-RPC -> EnterpriseShell in the iOS simulator with mimicked hardware (badge reader, kiosk state, injected signals via DemoMode flags).
`evidence` needs SIGNALGRID_MCP_PATH=~/Public/Projects/SignalGrid/signalgrid-mcp and refreshes artifacts/live-evidence/mac-run.json, which check-live-sync currently reports STALE.
A simulator cannot be MDM-enrolled and no real reader is attached — that boundary is the platform-honesty law, not a gap in this run.
